title: Voyageurs National Park
summary: Voyageurs National Park spans 218,000 acres of lakes, forests, and streams in northern Minnesota. Established in 1975, the park is named after the French-Canadian Voyageurs who once navigated these abundant waters. Voyageurs National Park provides exceptional opportunities for recreation and exploration amidst landscapes rich in natural beauty, history, and cultural heritage.

title: Voyageurs National Park: Partial Trail Closure: Echo Bay (Nov. 6 - 22)
summary: A portion of the Echo Bay Trail in Kabetogama will be temporarily closed Nov. 6–22 during hunting season. The closure affects the easternmost section of the trail and is intended to minimize conflicts between trail users and promote visitor safety. Closure signs will be posted along the affected trail sections. Visitors are asked to respect all posted closures during this time.
